What's a Lobster?
Lobsters (yes, that’s what we call ourselves) possess distinctive voices and identities. While no one trait or skill defines us, our shared values lay the foundation for how we work together.
We champion the customer
We anchor every decision in the value we create for our customers. We succeed only when they do – listening deeply, anticipating their needs and turning complexity into clarity.
We go together
We love solving hard problems with great people. Collaboration multiplies our impact and we build stronger solutions by engaging diverse perspectives. We challenge ideas with respect, then commit fully to a shared direction.
We own the outcome
We take responsibility for what we deliver – not just the effort, but the impact. Trust deepens when we do what we say and we own our part in every success and setback.
We raise the bar
We're never done getting better. We continuously iterate, improve and learn from every outcome to get better each day.
What our values look like in action
We asked Lobsters what our values mean to them. Here's what they had to say.
Work remotely +
 connect completely
We operate from everywhere while maintaining the stop-by-the-snack cupboard camaraderie that usually comes from being in the same office. Our remote model allows you to work from wherever you’re most productive while staying connected and energized through regular team offsites and in-person hangs.
